text:
I absolutely love my portrait!! Heather was wonderful to work with! I got married at Disney but for some reason, my photographer never got a wedding picture with the castle in the background. Heather was able to add that and more!
I will definitely ask her to paint another picture for me in the future!

***Her work does not include the water marks in the portrait you actually receive! I added them to protect her work when uploading on here.

owner_reply.text: Stephanie, thank you so much! It was an honor to work for you!! I am looking forward to your next project!!
